sloka: वेदाश्च क्रतवश्चैव क्रतूनां फलमेव च ।यानि कृत्यानि लोकेषु सर्व एष रविः प्रभुः ।। ६.१०७.२४ ।।
transliteration: vedāśca kratavaścaiva kratūnāṁ phalameva ca ।yāni kṛtyāni lokeṣu sarva eṣa raviḥ prabhuḥ ।। 6.107.24 ।।

translations.english: "He is all vedas, as well as all the sacrifices as also the fruits of all sacrifices. He is the supreme controller of all actions in all worlds.
